observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 101.» (L14) in the right margin.
body L5: the second y of «ayyār» is printed broken, its tail a dot under the line; the 3 of «30» before it is printed broken (its middle did not print).
body L6: «tammūz cum 21»: the Arabic text (Part III, p. 100, line 13) gives لا, 31 days; the misprint is not among Nallino's addenda et emendanda; kept as printed.
body L8, L10, L13: «an–nayrūz», «al–farwardaǵān» and «al–mihraǵān» are italic; the left part of several lines of the page (among them L9, L12, L13 and L14) is printed with heavier ink.
body L9-L14: the Persian names are joined to «māh» by the longer dash (measured 4.3 to 5.3 pt), except «ābān-māh» on L10, which has a hyphen (2.6 pt).
body L16: the tail of the y of «kiyahk» is printed as a dot under the line.
body L16-L19: the Greek names are printed with the open theta ϑ; the breathings of «ἀϑύρ», «ἐπιφί» and «ἐπαγόμενα» are smooth (compared with set smooth and rough breathings).

body L18: «bawūnəh»: the letter before the last h is printed as a turned e (ə), round, without the stem of an a (compared with the a of «ba-» in the same word); the name is بؤنه, bawūnah; kept as printed. «μεσορῆ» is printed with a circumflex over the η (2.97 x 1.29 pt), where the name has the acute (μεσορή); kept as printed.
body L22: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 32 the letters begin again at a.
notes_left L9: «Abū ’l-faraǵ» is letter-spaced; the g has the acute.
notes_right L12: the a of «a die» is printed blotted.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
